description: This false-colour satellite image depicts a complex of aquaculture fish ponds and surrounding agricultural land, illustrating a typical pattern found in the Třeboňsko region of the Czech Republic. In this false-colour representation, actively vegetated areas are rendered in shades of pink and red, while water bodies appear dark blue or black, and less vegetated or bare ground is shown in lighter, desaturated tones. The central feature is a rectangular area containing numerous individual, regularly shaped, dark blue water bodies, identifying them as highly transformed fish ponds. There are approximately 24 smaller ponds arranged in two parallel rows within a larger fenced or dikes-defined perimeter. Adjacent to this complex, towards the top right, is a single, larger, dark blue rectangular water body, also indicative of an artificial pond or reservoir. These water features are bordered by linear structures, likely dikes or access roads, which appear as thin reddish-pink and light grey lines. Surrounding the aquaculture facility are extensive, geometrically shaped agricultural fields, visible in varying shades of pink/red and light blue-green, exhibiting linear patterns consistent with cultivated crops or ploughed land.
